notes: The 3D shoe viewer now renders with your phone's own built-in browser engine instead of the app's renderer, so the shoe appears and turns under your finger on phones where the previous engine failed
Leaving the 3D viewer no longer closes the app: the model's resources are released in the order the renderer requires, which fixes a shutdown crash present in the previous build
The shoe itself is unchanged — the same verified model already on your device, nothing downloaded — and the Try On in AR button works as before
